results.title: Animal scents can help monitor tigers, leopards in the wild: NCBS study
results.description: Big cats leave behind scent marks as they move through forests, depositing urine and scat containing volatile organic compounds (VOCs) that convey information to other animals.

results.description: Elsie Hendershot and John Lucian Goins have powered Chicago’s late-season surge, helping the Slice sneak into the MLP Playoffs as the No. 12 seed. Now, the teenage duo will look to make an impact against Palm Beach.

results.title: Pakistan-Turkiye-Saudi Pact: Is US Losing Its Grip On West Asia?
